verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ עַֽל־ יְדוּת֗וּן מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד׃ אַ֣ךְ אֶל־ אֱ֭לֹהִים דּֽוּמִיָּ֣ה נַפְשִׁ֑י מִ֝מֶּ֗נּוּ יְשׁוּעָתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: lam·naṣ·ṣê·aḥ ‘al- yə·ḏū·ṯūn miz·mō·wr lə·ḏā·wiḏ ’aḵ ’el- ’ĕ·lō·hîm dū·mî·yāh nap̄·šî mim·men·nū yə·šū·‘ā·ṯî
verses.literal: For the choirmaster According to Jeduthun A Psalm of David In God alone my soul finds rest my salvation comes from Him

verses.original: אַךְ־ ה֣וּא צ֭וּרִי וִֽישׁוּעָתִ֑י מִ֝שְׂגַּבִּ֗י לֹא־ אֶמּ֥וֹט רַבָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’aḵ- hū ṣū·rî wî·šū·‘ā·ṯî miś·gab·bî lō- ’em·mō·wṭ rab·bāh
verses.literal: He alone is my rock and my salvation He is my fortress I will never be shaken . . .

verses.original: עַד־ אָ֤נָה׀ תְּהֽוֹתְת֣וּ עַל אִישׁ֮ תְּרָצְּח֪וּ כֻ֫לְּכֶ֥ם כְּקִ֥יר נָט֑וּי גָּ֝דֵ֗ר הַדְּחוּיָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ‘aḏ- ’ā·nāh tə·hō·wṯ·ṯū ʿal ’îš tə·rāṣ·ṣə·ḥū ḵul·lə·ḵem kə·qîr nā·ṭui gā·ḏêr had·də·ḥū·yāh
verses.literal: How long . . . will you threaten . . . a man Will all of you throw him down like a leaning wall or a tottering fence

verses.original: אַ֤ךְ מִשְּׂאֵת֨וֹ׀ יָעֲצ֣וּ לְהַדִּיחַ֮ יִרְצ֪וּ כָ֫זָ֥ב בְּפִ֥יו יְבָרֵ֑כוּ וּ֝בְקִרְבָּ֗ם יְקַלְלוּ־ סֶֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: ’aḵ miś·śə·’ê·ṯōw yā·‘ă·ṣū lə·had·dî·aḥ yir·ṣū ḵā·zāḇ bə·p̄îw yə·ḇā·rê·ḵū ū·ḇə·qir·bām yə·qal·lū- se·lāh
verses.literal: They fully intend to cast him down from his lofty perch they delight in lies with their mouths they bless but inwardly they curse . . . Selah

verses.original: אַ֣ךְ לֵ֭אלֹהִים דּ֣וֹמִּי נַפְשִׁ֑י כִּי־ מִ֝מֶּ֗נּוּ תִּקְוָתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’aḵ lê·lō·hîm dō·wm·mî nap̄·šî kî- mim·men·nū tiq·wā·ṯî
verses.literal: Rest in God alone O my soul for my hope comes from Him

verses.original: אַךְ־ ה֣וּא צ֭וּרִי וִֽישׁוּעָתִ֑י מִ֝שְׂגַּבִּ֗י לֹ֣א אֶמּֽוֹט׃
verses.literal: He alone is my rock and my salvation He is my fortress I will not be shaken

verses.original: עַל־ אֱ֭לֹהִים יִשְׁעִ֣י וּכְבוֹדִ֑י צוּר־ עֻזִּ֥י מַ֝חְסִ֗י בֵּֽאלֹהִֽים׃
verses.literal: My salvation and my honor rest on God my strong rock my refuge is in God

verses.original: בִּטְח֘וּ ב֤וֹ בְכָל־ עֵ֨ת׀ עָ֗ם שִׁפְכֽוּ־ לְפָנָ֥יו לְבַבְכֶ֑ם אֱלֹהִ֖ים מַחֲסֶה־ לָּ֣נוּ סֶֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: biṭ·ḥū ḇōw ḇə·ḵāl- ‘êṯ ‘ām šip̄·ḵū- lə·p̄ā·nāw lə·ḇaḇ·ḵem ’ĕ·lō·hîm ma·ḥă·seh- lā·nū se·lāh
verses.literal: Trust in Him at all times O people pour out your hearts before Him God is our refuge Selah

verses.original: אַ֤ךְ׀ הֶ֥בֶל בְּנֵֽי־ אָדָם֮ כָּזָ֪ב בְּנֵ֫י אִ֥ישׁ בְּמֹאזְנַ֥יִם לַעֲל֑וֹת הֵ֝֗מָּה מֵהֶ֥בֶל יָֽחַד׃
verses.transliteration: ’aḵ he·ḇel bə·nê- ’ā·ḏām kā·zāḇ bə·nê ’îš bə·mō·zə·na·yim la·‘ă·lō·wṯ hêm·māh mê·he·ḇel yā·ḥaḏ
verses.literal: Lowborn men are but a vapor the exalted . . . are but a lie Weighed on the scale they go up together they are but a vapor

verses.original: אַל־ תִּבְטְח֣וּ בְעֹשֶׁק֮ וּבְגָזֵ֪ל אַל־ תֶּ֫הְבָּ֥לוּ חַ֤יִל׀ כִּֽי־ יָנ֑וּב אַל־ תָּשִׁ֥יתוּ לֵֽב׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tiḇ·ṭə·ḥū ḇə·‘ō·šeq ū·ḇə·ḡā·zêl ’al- teh·bā·lū ḥa·yil kî- yā·nūḇ ’al- tā·šî·ṯū lêḇ
verses.literal: Place no trust in extortion or false hope . . . in stolen goods If your riches increase do not set your heart upon them

verses.original: אַחַ֤ת׀ דִּבֶּ֬ר אֱלֹהִ֗ים שְׁתַּֽיִם־ ז֥וּ שָׁמָ֑עְתִּי כִּ֥י עֹ֝֗ז לֵאלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ’a·ḥaṯ dib·ber ’ĕ·lō·hîm šə·ta·yim- zū šā·mā·‘ə·tî kî ‘ōz lê·lō·hîm
verses.literal: God has spoken once I have heard . . . this twice that power belongs to God

verses.original: וּלְךָֽ־ אֲדֹנָ֥י חָ֑סֶד כִּֽי־ אַתָּ֨ה תְשַׁלֵּ֖ם לְאִ֣ישׁ כְּֽמַעֲשֵֽׂהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·lə·ḵā- ’ă·ḏō·nāy ḥā·seḏ kî- ’at·tāh ṯə·šal·lêm lə·’îš kə·ma·‘ă·śê·hū
verses.literal: and loving devotion to You O Lord For You will repay each man according to his deeds
